# B2 vocabulary batch 105

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `overbook`, `overcoat`, `overemphasise`, `overemphasize`,
`overestimate`, `overhear`, `overlap`, `overly`, `overshadow`, `oversize`, `overstep`, `overthrow`,
`overturn`, `ow`, `ox`, `ozone`, `pa`, `paintbrush`, `pajamas`, `pallet`, `pandemic`, `paperless`,
`paradox`, `paralysis`, and `paramedic`.

The interjection example for `ow` was written as a complete sentence rather than dialogue punctuation
so the sentence checker can validate it consistently. All rows were checked for meaning, part of
speech, IPA, level, controlled topics, and original English/Vietnamese examples.
